name: @pipeworx/mcp-careeronestop

tools.name: careeronestop_salary
tools.description: What does <occupation> pay in <location> — wage percentiles (10th/25th/median/75th/90th, hourly + annual) for a U.S. occupation from the Dept. of Labor CareerOneStop API. Accepts an O*NET/SOC title or code. Example: careeronestop_salary({ occupation: "Registered Nurses", location: "TX", _apiKey: "userId:token" })

occupation.description: Occupation keyword, O*NET/SOC title, or code, e.g. "Registered Nurses" or "29-1141.00"

location.description: Location: state ("TX"), "City, State" ("Reston, VA"), ZIP ("20191"), or "US" for national data

tools.name: careeronestop_occupation
tools.description: Occupation detail (tasks, outlook, typical education) for <occupation> from the Dept. of Labor CareerOneStop / O*NET data. Example: careeronestop_occupation({ occupation: "Registered Nurses", _apiKey: "userId:token" })

occupation.description: Occupation keyword, O*NET/SOC title, or code, e.g. "Registered Nurses" or "29-1141.00"

location.description: Location: state ("TX"), "City, State", ZIP, or "US" for national. Defaults to "US".

tools.name: careeronestop_compare_salary
tools.description: Compare salaries across occupations — side-by-side wage data for multiple U.S. occupations from the Dept. of Labor CareerOneStop API. Example: careeronestop_compare_salary({ occupations: "Registered Nurses, Physician Assistants", location: "US", _apiKey: "userId:token" })

occupations.description: Comma-separated occupations (titles or O*NET/SOC codes), e.g. "Registered Nurses, 29-1171.00"

location.description: Location applied to every occupation: state, "City, State", ZIP, or "US" for national. Defaults to "US".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-careeronestop forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the careeronestop pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
